name: zkp2p-v2-contracts
description: V2 contracts for the ZK Peer to Peer fiat on/off-ramp
author: 0xsachink <0xsachink@gmail.com>

scripts.build: yarn clean && yarn compile && yarn build:ts:latest
scripts.clean: rm -f coverage.json; rm -rf .coverage_cache; rm -rf .coverage_contracts; rm -rf cache; rm -rf coverage; rm -rf typechain; rm -rf artifacts; rm -rf dist
scripts.coverage: yarn clean && yarn build && hardhat coverage --testfiles 'test/{libs,hooks,periphery,unifiedVerifier,registries,escrow,escrowV2,orchestrator,orchestratorV2,rateManager,staking,patchCoverage}/*.ts'
scripts.deploy:base: ts-node --transpile-only scripts/deployActive.ts base && hardhat export --network base --export ./deployments/outputs/baseContracts.ts && yarn workspace @zkp2p/contracts-v2 extract
scripts.deploy:base_staging: ts-node --transpile-only scripts/deployActive.ts base_staging && hardhat export --network base_staging --export ./deployments/outputs/baseStagingContracts.ts && yarn workspace @zkp2p/contracts-v2 extract
scripts.test: hardhat test test/libs/*.ts test/hooks/*.ts test/periphery/*.ts test/unifiedVerifier/*.ts test/registries/*.ts test/escrow/*.ts test/escrowV2/*.ts test/orchestrator/*.ts test/orchestratorV2/*.ts test/rateManager/*.ts test/staking/*.ts
